note: Held-out forced-choice (no-CoT) probes for the Veld entailment chain (Zorv->Plonk->Marn->Wexil->venomous). hop = DEDUCTIVE DEPTH = #chain links to compose. depth 0 = a literally-stated rule (no composition); depth k (1..4) = 'is a Zorv <k-th ancestor / venomous>?' requiring k composed rules. belief = logP(pos)-logP(neg); pos is always the LOGICALLY-CORRECT answer, so belief>0 = correct-direction (works for both forward entailments pos=Yes and converse/negation controls pos=No). Polarity 3:3 per depth cancels yes-bias. Entities are fictional => prior ~0 (no saturation, unlike tsunami h3). Split entailment (pos=' Yes') vs control (pos=' No') via the per_probe 'pos' field. DISJOINT from data/contexts/veld_contexts.json.
